# Copilot instructions

This repo makes Research Paper Cuts explainer videos. Read
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md), and
[the Muse/agent contract](../docs/08-muse-agent-contract.md) before making changes.
Use public npm; no Microsoft account, corporate registry, or internal CDN is required.
For an unscripted release reaction or record-first explainer without a paper,
use [the quick-take skill](skills/quick-take/SKILL.md) and
[the quick-take workflow](../docs/09-quick-takes.md).
